name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
    addon_type.name AS "Add-on:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:250",
    COUNT(addon_item.name) AS "Times Sold:Int:120"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type` addon_type
LEFT JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` addon_item
    ON addon_item.item = addon_type.name
    AND addon_item.parenttype = 'Airplane Ticket'
    AND addon_item.parentfield = 'add_ons'
GROUP BY addon_type.name
ORDER BY COUNT(addon_item.name) DESC, addon_type.name
